ns2:section.sectionText: Departmental approval required, contact the iSchool Internship Coordinator at ischool-internship@mx.uillinois.edu. This zero-credit course is for BSIS students who have been offered a part-time internship or co-op that is related to their major field of study. A brief reflection is required to receive the Satisfactory grade. For international students, this course can be used for Curricular Practical Training (CPT). For more information about this course and eligibility requirements, see: https://go.ischool.illinois.edu/IS269Internship
